title: Who will win the main MotoGP race at the 2026 British Grand Prix?
background: The main Grand Prix race is separate from the sprint race held during the same MotoGP weekend.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official MotoGP classification for the 2026 British Grand Prix main race at Silverstone. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the rider declared the winner of the main race scheduled for August 9, 2026. The sprint race does not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning rider's full name.
